title: Ways of seeing.
intro: Landscapes, wildlife, and life along the road.

photos.title: Looking up
photos.alt: A fox looks upward against a soft green background.

photos.title: Resting together
photos.alt: Several resting marine mammals press together, with a face centered between overlapping bodies.

photos.title: A quiet gesture
photos.alt: A blue bird lowers its head toward an extended wing while perched on a wooden edge.

photos.title: A pause in the grass
photos.alt: A bear stands in grass with its body in profile and its head turned toward the camera.

photos.title: At water level
photos.alt: A sea otter floats on its back with its forepaws raised beside its face, reflected in blue-green water.

photos.title: A long yawn
photos.alt: A sea otter floats on its back with its mouth open and its hind feet raised above the water.

photos.title: Floating company
photos.alt: A sea otter faces the camera in the foreground while another floats behind it with its mouth open and is out of focus.

photos.title: Ears in the sun
photos.alt: A long-eared rabbit sits in profile on stony desert ground, with sunlight passing through its raised ears.

photos.title: In profile
photos.alt: A sea lion raises its head in profile, with sunlight reflecting from its smooth coat against a softly blurred shore.

photos.title: Low over the water
photos.alt: A pelican flies low with its wings fully extended above deep blue ocean water.

photos.title: Mid-yawn
photos.alt: A sea lion stretches upward with its mouth wide open against a softly blurred coastal background.

photos.title: Through the surf
photos.alt: A sea lion emerges from churning water in black and white, with wet whiskers and foam surrounding its face.

photos.title: Three at rest
photos.alt: Three sea otters rest in a vertical sequence, their pale faces and dark wet bodies repeating across the frame.

photos.title: Raft of three
photos.alt: Three sea otters float closely together, their pale faces and dark bodies layered across calm blue water.

photos.title: Still water
photos.alt: A single sea otter rests upright with eyes gently closed, reflected in calm blue water.

photos.title: Adrift in kelp
photos.alt: A sea otter floats on its back among brown kelp, surrounded by a broad field of rippled blue water.

photos.title: Held close
photos.alt: Two sea otters rest against one another in the water, one pale face turned toward the camera in low light.

photos.title: Shake it off
photos.alt: A sea otter shakes water from its head and body, sending a burst of droplets through bright backlight.

photos.title: Looking back
photos.alt: A young sea otter looks directly toward the camera while resting against the dark wet body of another otter.

photos.title: Through the willows
photos.alt: A large antlered moose stands in profile among dense pale vegetation, its dark body contrasting with the surrounding branches.

photos.title: Small visitor
photos.alt: A small brown bird stands close to the camera against a sparkling, softly blurred ground.

photos.title: Into the deep
photos.alt: A whale raises its tail above the ocean as streams of water fall from both flukes.

photos.title: Marked flukes
photos.alt: The patterned underside of a whale tail rises above dark blue water, edged with droplets and white spray.

photos.title: A breath at sea
photos.alt: A large white plume rises above a whale surfacing low in the open ocean beneath a distant horizon.

photos.title: On the lawn
photos.alt: A common myna walks across grass against a soft green background.

photos.title: Pinecone lunch
photos.alt: A squirrel sits on a pine branch while eating from a pine cone.

collections.name: Land
collections.subtitle: Light, weather & natural forms
collections.description: Light, weather, water, and natural forms.

photos.title: Valley in the clouds
photos.alt: Clouds drift between steep rock walls above a forested valley and a waterfall.

photos.title: A heart in the water
photos.alt: A heart-shaped pool lies in an orange surface below a broad blue-green area.

photos.title: Evening cliffs
photos.alt: Pink and orange clouds cross the sky above steep cliffs and a dark meadow.

photos.title: Mineral patterns
photos.alt: Orange, white, and blue-gray bands curve across a geothermal surface.

photos.title: Clouds above the ridge
photos.alt: Snow-covered mountain peaks catch warm light beneath pink and blue clouds, with dark slopes in the foreground.

photos.title: Braided water
photos.alt: Pale branching river channels curve around steep canyon walls, with a bridge in the foreground and distant mountains beneath clouds.

photos.title: Folded earth
photos.alt: Closely spaced gray ridges and deep gullies form repeating diagonal patterns across a canyon wall.

photos.title: A single spire
photos.alt: A black-and-white photograph of a dark stone spire rising from a slope among pale, eroded hills.

photos.title: A winding channel
photos.alt: A dark winding channel crosses gray ridges and pale brown ground below a band of steep, eroded cliffs.

photos.title: Pale ridges
photos.alt: Pale ridges and layered rock faces recede across a nearly white badlands landscape.

photos.title: White columns
photos.alt: Tall white rock columns with dark brown capstones stand at different heights against a pale rock wall.

photos.title: Blue across the lake
photos.alt: Deep blue lake water fills the foreground beneath clouds wrapped around snow-covered mountains.

photos.title: Light beyond the water
photos.alt: Sunbeams pass through golden clouds above a dark lake and distant mountain ridges lined with wind turbines.

photos.title: Scale
photos.alt: A small cluster of trees stands alone in a broad meadow beneath a massive rocky mountain peak.

photos.title: Across the lake
photos.alt: Dark mountain ridges rise above a still lake beneath layered clouds in a black-and-white landscape.

photos.title: Tower in winter
photos.alt: A tall orange hoodoo rises from a snow-filled canyon, surrounded by layered rock walls and smaller spires.

photos.title: Through the stone
photos.alt: Snow-covered hoodoos and canyon walls appear through a naturally framed opening in warm orange rock.

photos.title: A long winter shadow
photos.alt: A broken tree trunk stands alone on a smooth snow ridge, casting a long shadow toward distant snowy hoodoos.

photos.title: Blue shadow
photos.alt: A soft blue shadow curves across an untouched snow drift beneath a narrow band of orange earth.

photos.title: After the storm
photos.alt: A broad snow-covered canyon of orange hoodoos stretches beneath large white clouds and a deep blue winter sky.

photos.title: Stone forest
photos.alt: Dense orange hoodoos rise in vertical layers among scattered dark green pine trees.

photos.title: Orange country
photos.alt: Rolling orange and pale ridges stretch across the canyon around an isolated hoodoo and scattered pine trees.

photos.title: Last light on the plateau
photos.alt: Warm evening light falls across a layered red plateau beneath large blue-gray storm clouds.

photos.title: Under the cap
photos.alt: Warm sunlight passes through the delicate gills of a small mushroom growing from dark tree bark, with other fungi fading into soft focus.

photos.title: Rainforest ridges
photos.alt: Dark green tropical ridges rise behind sunlit foreground trees.

photos.title: Diamond Head above Honolulu
photos.alt: Diamond Head rises above Honolulu with the Pacific Ocean beyond.

photos.title: Diamond Head and the city
photos.alt: Diamond Head stretches across the horizon above dense Honolulu neighborhoods.

photos.title: Cloud over the basin
photos.alt: A long sculpted cloud hangs over a broad desert basin beneath a deep blue sky.

photos.title: Cloud above the Sierra
photos.alt: A glowing orange cloud floats above a jagged Sierra ridge at dusk.

photos.title: Autumn shoreline
photos.alt: Turquoise Lake Tahoe water meets granite boulders and yellow autumn foliage below pine forest.

photos.title: Tahoe afterglow
photos.alt: A snow-dusted Sierra ridge stands beneath pink and blue evening clouds across Lake Tahoe.

photos.title: Granite above the valley
photos.alt: A massive Yosemite granite wall rises above forest, meadow, and a winding river far below.

photos.title: At the edge
photos.alt: A tiny hiker climbs across a high granite outcrop above hazy layered mountain ridges.

photos.title: Half Dome at evening
photos.alt: Half Dome rises above surrounding Sierra ridges in restrained evening light.

photos.title: Under the Milky Way
photos.alt: The Milky Way crosses the night sky above a silhouetted person shining a blue flashlight beam.

photos.title: Half Dome after dark
photos.alt: A dense star field and the Milky Way rise above the dark silhouette of Half Dome.

photos.title: Cliff at twilight
photos.alt: A towering granite cliff stands beneath pink-purple twilight clouds with a tiny person at its base.

photos.title: Fire over granite
photos.alt: Orange and pink sunset clouds sweep above a large illuminated granite wall.

photos.title: Through the arch
photos.alt: A red sandstone arch frames snow-covered mountains with a small person standing below.

photos.title: Two arches
photos.alt: Two large red sandstone arches rise beneath textured blue and white clouds.

photos.title: Two figures above the clouds
photos.alt: Two small figures sit beside a lone tree on a dry hillside above an expansive cloud layer.

photos.title: Columns in shadow
photos.alt: Repeated pale natural columns cast deep shadows across the exposed formations at Lake Crowley.

photos.title: Between the columns
photos.alt: Tall pale columns frame the exposed lakebed, distant mountains, and a small person.

photos.title: The exposed colonnade
photos.alt: A long wall of pale Crowley Lake columns stretches beneath a blue sky and distant mountain.

photos.title: Looking up in the canyon
photos.alt: A person looks upward between tall flowing red sandstone walls inside Antelope Canyon.

photos.title: Flowing stone
photos.alt: Warm orange sandstone curves around a bright opening in a narrow slot canyon.

photos.title: Purple curves
photos.alt: Purple-red sandstone walls sweep around a glowing orange opening in Antelope Canyon.

photos.title: Dust in the light
photos.alt: Sunlit airborne sand glows between dark red canyon walls.

photos.title: Through the window
photos.alt: Snow-covered mountains appear through tall windows and are reflected in a table inside.

photos.title: The last light
photos.alt: People and a flying bird are silhouetted between trees above a sunlit street.

photos.title: Passage in green
photos.alt: An ivy-covered brick passage frames trees and a walkway, with bicycles parked along both sides.

photos.title: Windows after dark
photos.alt: Warmly lit windows repeat across a dark brick wall, partly covered by climbing green plants.

photos.title: Blossoms and glass
photos.alt: White blossoms fill the foreground beneath a pale blue sky, with a softly focused skyscraper behind them.

photos.title: Between towers
photos.alt: A tower with an illuminated sphere stands between closely framed glass buildings in blue and magenta light.

photos.title: Lines and lamps
photos.alt: Two curved lamp shades stand at different heights against alternating vertical bands of beige stone and green glass.

photos.title: Lake road
photos.alt: A dark SUV follows a curving lakeside road toward sunlit green hills, conifer-covered slopes, and low clouds.

photos.title: Hills in gold
photos.alt: Layers of hills, scattered buildings, trees, and palms recede into golden haze.

photos.title: City lights
photos.alt: Illuminated city buildings stand beneath a pink and purple sky crossed by thin, curved clouds.

photos.title: Late light on the steps
photos.alt: A seated person looks at a phone on concrete steps crossed by a metal handrail in warm late-afternoon light.

photos.title: Concrete rhythms
photos.alt: Repeating concrete overhangs and glass windows form a geometric pattern against a clear blue sky.

photos.title: Framed by concrete
photos.alt: A small house perched above a distant building is framed beneath a massive concrete overhang and a nearby tree.

photos.title: Pink walls, still water
photos.alt: A pale pink building, palms, and an arched green doorway are reflected in a calm pond under bright sunlight.

photos.title: Pier at dusk
photos.alt: A Ferris wheel rises above a busy pier as people gather on the beach and birds cross a pale evening sky.

photos.title: Tower 14 at blue hour
photos.alt: Lifeguard towers recede along a quiet beach beneath layered hills in cool blue evening light.

photos.title: Palm shadow
photos.alt: A large palm shadow falls across a white stucco wall while dark green fronds enter from the upper right.

photos.title: A golden opening
photos.alt: An ornate amber-lit arched interior detail is seen through a softly blurred geometric opening.

photos.title: Light beside the painting
photos.alt: A glowing geometric pendant lamp hangs beside a framed painting dominated by deep blue and warm red tones.

photos.title: Mission towers
photos.alt: Two pale stone bell towers with pink domes rise sharply against a clear deep-blue sky.

photos.title: Chapel beneath the peaks
photos.alt: A small dark log chapel stands below the rocky Teton Range, with a wooden cross rising against the mountains.

photos.title: Passing by the barn
photos.alt: A weathered wooden barn sits beneath the Teton Range while a small couple in light clothing walks beside the fence.

photos.title: Napa in autumn
photos.alt: The Napa County emblem is mounted on a pale wall and framed by softly blurred yellow and orange autumn leaves.

photos.title: Toward the house
photos.alt: A vineyard road leads toward three walkers and a hillside house, framed by rows of yellow and orange vines.

photos.title: Sunset behind us
photos.alt: A car side mirror reflects an empty highway running toward mountains beneath a warm sunset, while the surrounding landscape falls into cool blue light.

photos.title: Through the old cab
photos.alt: Vineyard rows and a distant house are framed through the weathered windows and steering wheel of an old truck.

photos.title: Behind the branches
photos.alt: An ornate stone-and-wood building with a tall central window is partly framed by dark twisting tree branches and autumn foliage.

photos.title: Glass and warm light
photos.alt: A decorative stained-glass panel sits above a dark window reflecting warm interior lights, surrounded by pale stone and blurred autumn foliage.

photos.title: On deck
photos.alt: A crew member gestures from the deck of a white boat beneath a clear blue sky.

photos.title: Temple and reflection
photos.alt: The classical Pulgas Water Temple stands between tall cypress trees and is reflected in a long turquoise pool.

photos.title: Road to the Pacific
photos.alt: A long city street runs through Honolulu toward high-rises and the Pacific Ocean.

photos.title: Looking over Honolulu
photos.alt: Two people sit on a hillside overlooking Honolulu and Diamond Head in warm evening light.

photos.title: Last light over the Pacific
photos.alt: A small aircraft and a ship cross the Pacific beneath glowing sunset clouds.

photos.title: Freight across the desert
photos.alt: A yellow Union Pacific locomotive crosses a pale desert basin backed by mountains.

photos.title: Among the giants
photos.alt: A Volvo XC90 sits on a forest road beneath towering giant sequoias.

photos.title: Steel and timber
photos.alt: A Cybertruck is parked beside a massive fallen sequoia in a forest clearing.

photos.title: Above the foothills
photos.alt: A person sits on a rock ledge at blue hour above layered Sierra foothills and distant lights.

photos.title: Richfield
photos.alt: A weathered vintage truck sits beside an abandoned Richfield service station.

photos.title: Apse in color
photos.alt: Stained-glass windows and mosaics fill the apse of Stanford Memorial Church.

photos.title: Under the dome
photos.alt: Arches, mosaics, stained glass, and a circular dome fill the interior of Stanford Memorial Church.

photos.title: The central dome
photos.alt: A circular skylight and four illuminated angel mosaics form a symmetrical ceiling pattern.

photos.title: Nave and organ
photos.alt: The nave of Stanford Memorial Church leads toward the organ beneath a warm wooden ceiling.

photos.title: Road to Half Dome
photos.alt: A Volvo XC90 sits on a curving mountain road with Half Dome filling the background.

photos.title: Above the fog
photos.alt: A car and a small person stop beside a lone tree on a golden ridge above a sea of fog.
